title: New Orleans Municipal Yacht Harbor

services.name: Fishing Pier
services.desc: The West End Fishing Pier offers free public access to Lake Pontchartrain - no fee to use, just bring your gear and your Louisiana fishing license. The pier is open to anglers of all experience levels, and crab nets are welcome (3 per person or 5 per group). Call the harbor office to confirm current slip availability or start your application online. Aerial Photography Courtesy of Moffatt & Nichol - Designed by Magnific - Custom Website by Firefly Marketing
